'''Issa DaVoren''' is a girl from [[Aturo's Orchard]].

== History ==
Issa is the daughter of the farmer couple [[Fenton DaVoren|Fenton]] and [[Annabelle DaVoren]], and she has a brother named [[Tobias DaVoren|Tobias]].

His town is attacked by [[Whitecloaks]], and the farm is left in ruin. Issa is separated from her family, and is terrified of the attackers. She is eventually taken to her uncle [[Hobbs DaVoren|Hobbs]], the owner of the [[Three Crowns Inn]].<ref name="RPG">''[[The Wheel of Time Roleplaying Game]]''</ref>
